name: Boostiq by AI SEO Booster
author: ai901

sections.description:
Boostiq is the WordPress connector for AI SEO Booster. The service reads your site the way a search engine does, works out what is holding each page back, and then makes the changes — with you approving them, on your own pages, on a schedule.

It is built for small local businesses: a roofer, a remodeller, an auto glass shop. You do not need to know what a meta description is, and you never have to write one.

It requires an AI SEO Booster account to do anything. This plugin is the connector; the analysis happens on our servers, using your Google Search Console data, your competitors and your own pages. On its own the plugin does nothing except generate a key and wait.

Once you paste that key into your AI SEO Booster dashboard, the service can:

  • Read your published pages and posts, and their current SEO settings
  • Write page titles, meta descriptions and headings
  • Add internal links between your pages
  • Publish new pages you have approved, and remove ones it created
  • Add alt text to images that have none
  • Create redirects, and hide a page from search or show it again
  • Clear your page cache so a change appears straight away
  • Tell search engines a page has changed, using IndexNow

It works alongside Yoast SEO and Rank Math, writing through their fields rather than competing with them.

What it will not do. It does not change your theme, your design or your templates. It does not touch products, orders or customer records. It does not read or transmit your visitors’ personal data. Every change it makes is recorded and can be undone.

Account required

This plugin is a client for a third-party service, AI SEO Booster, operated by AI SEO Booster LLC. The plugin is free and GPL and its code is complete and unrestricted — there is no paid tier of the plugin, no locked feature, no trial timer and nothing switched off inside it.

It has no standalone function to restrict. It adds no SEO tools to your admin, writes nothing by itself and decides nothing by itself; what to write is worked out by the remote service from your Google Search Console data, your competitors and your own pages. The plugin is the door that service comes through, and the key on your settings screen is what you give it. Every endpoint is there to answer that service and nothing else.

Without an account the plugin simply has nothing to do — the same way an email-delivery or spam-filter connector does nothing until it is pointed at its service.

What the service costs

Three plans, billed monthly, and five free days on any of them.

  • Essentials — $149/month. Up to 8 new pages a month, 10 towns, 5 services.
  • Growth — $249/month. Up to 20 pages a month, 25 towns, 10 services, plus competitor tracking, backlinks, Google Business Profile and AI-assistant visibility.
  • Complete — $349/month. Up to 40 pages a month, 50 towns, 20 services, plus link outreach and review replies.

A card is required to start the five free days, and nothing is charged until they end. Cancel during them and you pay nothing. Current prices and what each plan includes are on the pricing page, which is the authority if this list and that page ever disagree.

The plugin itself is free, GPL and unrestricted. None of the above is enforced inside it.

External services

This plugin does not contact any external service on its own. It only answers requests from AI SEO Booster, and only when they carry the API key generated on your own site.

One optional feature sends data out: if you enable the tap tracker, a visitor tapping a phone-number or email link records that it happened and on which page. It records no personal information about the visitor. This is sent to AI SEO Booster’s servers so the count appears in your dashboard.

Service terms: https://app.aiseobooster.ai/terms
Service privacy policy: https://app.aiseobooster.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → AI SEO Booster.
  3. Copy the API key shown there.
  4. Paste it into your AI SEO Booster dashboard, under Connect your website.

That is the whole setup. If you ever want to cut the connection, press Generate a new key on that settings screen and the old key stops working immediately.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid account?

Yes, eventually. The plugin is the connector for the AI SEO Booster service; on its own it generates a key and does nothing else.

You get five free days to try the service. A card is taken when you sign up and is not charged until those five days are over, so cancelling inside them costs nothing.

Will it change how my site looks?

No. It does not touch your theme, your templates or your design. New pages it publishes are built from a design taken from one of your existing pages, so they match the rest of your site.

Can it break something?

Every change is recorded and reversible from your dashboard in one click. It will not edit a page you wrote without that change being listed.

Does it slow my site down?

No. It adds no scripts or styles to your public pages. The optional tap tracker is a few lines of JavaScript and nothing else.

What data leaves my site?

Only what AI SEO Booster asks for, and only with your key: the text and SEO settings of your published pages. No customer data, no orders, no form submissions, no user accounts.

How do I disconnect it?

Press Generate a new key on the settings screen, or deactivate the plugin. Either stops access immediately.
sections.changelog:
1.0.34

  • Deletes temporary uploads with wp_delete_file() so a host that stores uploads elsewhere can intercept it.
  • Unslashes and sanitises the visitor address used to rate-limit the public tap endpoint, and the request path used by the redirect and IndexNow routes.

1.0.33

  • First release on the WordPress.org directory.
  • Updates are handled by WordPress.org; the plugin contains no update code of its own.
